<thought>Based on the observed isotopic pattern—a relatively strong M+1 peak (~13 % of the base peak) indicating the presence of many carbon atoms, and a pronounced M+2 peak (~33 % of the base peak) matching the characteristic 35Cl/37Cl isotopic ratio—we can definitively identify carbon and chlorine in the sample.</thought>
<final_answer>['C', 'Cl']</final_answer>
